extracted.intended_audience: inventors, patent/design/trade-mark agents, and legal practitioners (United Kingdom)
extracted.subtask_description: Requirements and procedural rules under the Patents, Designs, and Trade Marks Act 1883 (and accompanying Rules and Instructions) for obtaining, maintaining, amending, opposing, and enforcing patents, registered designs, and trade marks in the United Kingdom.

rubrics_metrics.name: Short title and commencement
rubrics_metrics.description: Sections setting out the short title of the Act and the date(s) on which the Act (or parts thereof) commence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Division of Act into Parts
rubrics_metrics.description: Organisational division of the Act into parts (Preliminary; Patents; Designs; Trade Marks; General).

rubrics_metrics.name: Persons entitled to apply for patent
rubrics_metrics.description: Who may make an application for a patent (entitlement to apply).

rubrics_metrics.name: Application and specification
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements for an application and the form and content of the specification (provisional and complete).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes Forms in First Schedule and Rules/Instructions about content, signatures, and supporting documents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reference of application to examiner
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedure for referring patent applications to an examiner for consideration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Power for Comptroller to refuse application or require amendment
rubrics_metrics.description: Comptroller's authority to refuse an application or to require amendment of the specification or application documents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Time for leaving complete specification
rubrics_metrics.description: Time limits within which an applicant must file a complete specification following a provisional application or other trigger.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comparison of provisional and complete specification
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules governing how the provisional and complete specifications are to be compared (scope/consistency).

rubrics_metrics.name: Advertisement on acceptance of complete specification
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirement for advertisement/publication of acceptance of a complete specification in the Patent Office's illustrated journal (or equivalent).

rubrics_metrics.name: Opposition to grant of patent
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures, grounds, and timeframes for third parties to oppose the grant of a patent.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rules and Forms included (Opposition, Hearings, Notices).

rubrics_metrics.name: Sealing and date of patent
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures for sealing a patent and the method for determining the date of the patent (priority/effective date).

rubrics_metrics.name: Provisional protection
rubrics_metrics.description: Legal effect and scope of provisional protection conferred by filing a provisional specification (and related limitations).

rubrics_metrics.name: Effect of acceptance of complete specification
rubrics_metrics.description: Legal consequences that flow from acceptance of the complete specification (scope of protection from provisional/complete filings).

rubrics_metrics.name: Extent of patent
rubrics_metrics.description: Geographical and subject-matter extent of the monopoly conferred by a patent.

rubrics_metrics.name: Term of patent
rubrics_metrics.description: Statutory duration of patent protection and any provisions for extension (including petitions to the Queen in Council).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes Section 25 on extension of term on petition to the Queen in Council.

rubrics_metrics.name: Amendment of specification
rubrics_metrics.description: When and how a specification may be amended, including during proceedings; power to require disclaimers and effect on damages.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes Rules/Forms for application to amend, opposition to amendment, advertisement of amendment, and restriction on recovery of damages after amendment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Power to disclaim part of invention during action
rubrics_metrics.description: Ability to disclaim parts of an invention (narrow scope) as a defence or during litigation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Compulsory licences
rubrics_metrics.description: Power for the Board (or authority) to order the grant of licences under certain conditions (e.g., public interest, non-working).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes procedure (applications, petitions) and Rules/Forms for compulsory licence proceedings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Register of patents
rubrics_metrics.description: Maintenance and content of the official Register of Patents, and entries required to record grants, assignments, licences, payments, and other particulars.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rules as to inspection, entries of subsequent proprietorship, certified copies, and rectification by court.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fees
rubrics_metrics.description: Schedule of statutory fees for applications, renewals, entries, and other patent office transactions as set out in the Second Schedule/Rules.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Patent Rules and First/Second Schedules list detailed fees and methods of payment (including special rules for applications pending on specified dates).

rubrics_metrics.name: Revocation of patent
rubrics_metrics.description: Grounds and procedure for revoking a patent (including actions in court and summary procedures).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes Sections on legal proceedings, evidence, and costs when validity is questioned.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patent to bind the Crown
rubrics_metrics.description: Effect of patents vis-à-vis the Crown and any special rules for Government use or assignments to Government (e.g., Secretary for War).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contains a saving/reservation and specific provisions for certain assignments to the Secretary for War.

rubrics_metrics.name: Legal proceedings and remedies
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedural rules for hearings (including assessors), delivery of particulars, orders for inspection, certificates of validity, remedies for groundless threats, costs, and enforcement of rights.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes Rules on evidence, attendance of witnesses, cross-examination, and certificates of the Comptroller as evidence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patent for one invention only
rubrics_metrics.description: Restriction that a patent should be for one invention only and rules for applications claiming multiple inventions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Patent Rules include provisions for applying for more than one invention and for division.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patent for representative of deceased inventor
rubrics_metrics.description: Provision allowing application or grant on behalf of a deceased inventor's representative.

rubrics_metrics.name: First inventor rule and fraud
rubrics_metrics.description: A patent to the first inventor is not invalidated by an application made in fraud of him; treatment of fraudulent applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assignments and territorial limitations
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules on assignment of patents (including assignments for particular places) and registration of assignments in the register.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedures for entry of assignments and transmissions and inspection of registers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Loss or destruction of patent
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedure and remedy in case of loss or destruction of patent documents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proceedings before law officers; costs
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedure and allocation of costs for matters referred to legal officers and conduct of proceedings before them.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exhibition protections
rubrics_metrics.description: Provisions that exhibition of an invention at industrial or international exhibitions shall not prejudice patent rights or registration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publication in illustrated journal and Patent Museum; models
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules on publication (illustrated journal), indexes, Patent Museum, and the Comptroller's power to require models subject to payment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Patent Instructions contain details on drawings, models, and requirements for illustrated journal submissions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Foreign vessels and Crown matters
rubrics_metrics.description: Special rules as to foreign vessels in British waters and the effect of certain inventions assigned to government departments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provisions respecting existing patents
rubrics_metrics.description: Transitional rules and savings relating to patents existing prior to the Act coming into force.

rubrics_metrics.name: Definitions of patent, patentee, and invention
rubrics_metrics.description: Statutory definitions used throughout the patent provisions (what constitutes a patent, patentee, invention).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: General definitions appear in sections 46 and 117 and elsewhere.

rubrics_metrics.name: Registration of designs — application requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements and form for application to register designs, including drawings/sketches and specimens to be furnished.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Designs Rules and Instructions give detailed requirements for number/size/views and marking of goods.

rubrics_metrics.name: Certificate of registration and copyright in registered designs
rubrics_metrics.description: Issuance of certificate on registration and the copyright consequences (copyright in registered designs and marking requirements).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes marking obligations, inspection rights, and cessation of copyright in certain events.

rubrics_metrics.name: Register of designs and fees
rubrics_metrics.description: Maintenance of the Register of Designs and schedule of fees on registration and related transactions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: First/Second Schedules to Designs Rules list fees and Forms for registration, copy certificates, and legal use.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inspection, penalties, and legal remedies for design piracy
rubrics_metrics.description: Inspection rights of registered designs, penalties for piracy, and civil remedies including damages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Definition of 'design' and 'proprietor'
rubrics_metrics.description: Statutory definitions determining what is a registrable design and who is a proprietor.

rubrics_metrics.name: Registration of trade marks — application and time limits
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements for application to register trade marks, time limits to proceed with applications, and formal conditions for registration.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Trade Marks Rules and Instructions provide detailed Forms and procedural steps (acknowledgement, classification of goods).

rubrics_metrics.name: Conditions and restrictions of registration
rubrics_metrics.description: Substantive conditions under which a trade mark may or may not be registered (distinctiveness, connection with goods, restrictions, saving for common marks).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sections 64–74 set out various limits and special cases; Rules clarify classification and common marks handling.

rubrics_metrics.name: Series of marks, colours, and representations
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules allowing registration of a series of marks, registration in any colour, required number/size of representations (and special rules for metal goods).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Trade Marks Instructions specify number and format of representations (e.g., woodblocks/electrotypes for the Trade Marks Journal).

rubrics_metrics.name: Advertisement, opposition and counter-statements
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirement to advertise applications, procedures for opposition to registration, and forms/contents of counter-statements and security for costs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Instructions include two new forms: counter-statement where there is opposition, and form for security for costs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assignment, transmission and conflicting claims
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules for assignment and transmission of trade marks, registration of subsequent proprietors, and resolution of conflicting claims between applicants.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes hearing procedures and forms for entry of subsequent proprietors and orders of court.

rubrics_metrics.name: Effect of registration and limitations on actions
rubrics_metrics.description: Legal effect of registration (equivalence to public use), exclusive rights of first proprietor, and statutory restrictions on infringement actions and defences.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes removal after 14 years unless fee paid and other limitations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Register of trade marks; removal after 14 years
rubrics_metrics.description: Maintenance of the Register of Trade Marks and provision for removal of a mark after fourteen years unless renewal fee is paid.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fees for trade marks and classification of goods
rubrics_metrics.description: Schedule of fees payable for trade mark registration and related transactions; power for Board of Trade to make rules for classifying goods.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Third Schedule to Trade Marks Rules provides classification of goods; First/Second Schedules list fees and forms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cutlers' Company (Sheffield Marks)
rubrics_metrics.description: Special provision allowing the Cutlers' Company of Sheffield to register Sheffield marks under specified rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patent Office organisation and procedural powers
rubrics_metrics.description: Provisions about the Patent Office (officers, seal, hours), Comptroller's discretionary powers, clerical corrections, and power to take directions of law officers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rules include powers to dispense with evidence, correct clerical errors, and exercise discretion.

rubrics_metrics.name: Entry and inspection of registers; certified copies and evidence
rubrics_metrics.description: Rights to inspect registers, obtain extracts/certified copies, and the evidentiary weight of such copies and Comptroller certificates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rectification of registers by court
rubrics_metrics.description: Court power to rectify entries in patent/design/trade mark registers and procedures for applying for correction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applications and notices by post; days for leaving documents
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules permitting applications and notices by post and provisions as to days and places for leaving documents at the Office.

rubrics_metrics.name: Declarations by infants, lunatics, and representatives
rubrics_metrics.description: Special rules and declarations required where applicants or proprietors are infants, lunatics, or where transmission is by personal representatives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transmission of certified printed copies of specifications
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedure for transmitting certified printed copies of specifications and related documents (for evidence/use abroad).

rubrics_metrics.name: Power for Board of Trade to make general rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Delegated power for the Board of Trade to make general rules for classifying goods and regulating the business of the Patent Office.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Implemented via Patents/Designs/Trade Marks Rules and Schedules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Annual reports of Comptroller
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirement for the Comptroller to prepare and publish annual reports on the Office's activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: International and colonial arrangements
rubrics_metrics.description: Provisions enabling international arrangements for the protection of inventions, designs, and trade marks and special provisions for colonies and India.

rubrics_metrics.name: Offences and penalties
rubrics_metrics.description: Penalties for false representations (e.g., falsely representing articles to be patented), unauthorised use of Royal Arms, falsification of register entries, and other offences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scotland/Ireland/Isle of Man provisions and savings
rubrics_metrics.description: Special procedural savings and provisions preserving jurisdiction and court procedures in Scotland, Ireland, and the Isle of Man.

rubrics_metrics.name: Repeals, transitional provisions and savings
rubrics_metrics.description: Repeal of prior enactments and savings for past operations, continued effect of former registers/rules, and other transitional arrangements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Forms, precedents and schedules
rubrics_metrics.description: Extensive First, Second and Third Schedules and Appendices containing prescribed Forms of Application, Notices, Pleadings, Orders, Fees, Classification tables, and Precedents to be used under the Act.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Patents/Designs/Trade Marks Rules each have their own First and Second Schedules (fees and forms); Appendices include pleadings, agreements, and Privy Council rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patent/Design/Trade Marks Rules — business procedures and technical requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Detailed procedural Rules covering interpretation, forms, fees, hours, agency/authorisation, size/number of documents/drawings/representations, sending documents by post, affidavits, numbering, enlargement of time, and discretionary powers of the Comptroller.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rules specify many technicalities (e.g., size of drawings, number of representations for trade marks, size/number of woodblocks/electrotypes for Trade Marks Journal).

rubrics_metrics.name: Patent/Design/Trade Marks Instructions — practical directions
rubrics_metrics.description: Instructions issued by the Comptroller elaborating practical steps and administrative details for applicants and agents (including where to get stamped forms, how fees are to be paid, powers of agents, and specific formats for journals and drawings).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Preface notes that Instructions contain matters such as agent authorisation methods and detailed requirements for journal illustrations; two new Forms added in Trade Marks Instructions (counter-statement and security for costs).

rubrics_metrics.name: Appeals and hearings (to law officer, Board of Trade, Judicial Committee, Cutlers' Company)
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures, time limits, notices, evidence, and hearing arrangements for appeals to the law officer, Board of Trade, Judicial Committee, and special bodies (e.g., Cutlers' Company for Sheffield marks).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rules include time for appeal, notice requirements, transmission of papers, enlargement of time, and evidence handling (cross-examination, attendance of witnesses).

rubrics_metrics.name: Forms of pleading, agreements, licences, assignments, mortgages
rubrics_metrics.description: Prescribed precedents and forms for pleadings, court orders, agreements, assignments, licences and mortgages associated with patents, designs and trade marks.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Appendices A and B contain practical precedents and forms for legal proceedings and commercial instruments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Certificates for use abroad and use in legal proceedings
rubrics_metrics.description: Forms and procedures for obtaining certificates to obtain registration abroad and for certified copies/certificates to be used in legal proceedings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Second Schedules and Forms include applications for such certificates and requests for copies of official notices.
